load_yaml_from_file: create a python module that uses YamlHandler to load a YAML config file from disk into a dict
dump_yaml_to_file: create a python module that uses YamlHandler to dump a dictionary to a YAML file on disk
dump_yaml_to_string: create a python module that uses YamlHandler to serialize a dictionary to a YAML string
review_YamlHandler_class: review the YamlHandler class and its load_from_fileobj, dump_to_fileobj, and dump_to_str methods
test_YamlHandler_roundtrip: test the YamlHandler by dumping a dict to YAML and loading it back to verify equality
